summary.warning: This is a small in-domain diagnostic set with one annotator. It is not a production groundedness accuracy claim or a calibrated decision threshold.

trials.source: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
trials.claim: A vLLM block table maps logical KV blocks to physical KV blocks.

trials.source: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

trials.source: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

trials.source: SGLang Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs

trials.source: SGLang Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs

trials.source: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
